name: stageflow-workspace
description: Workspace-level scripts for the StageFlow monorepo

scripts.precommit:web: cd clients/web && bun run check && bun run test
scripts.precommit:scanner: cd services/scanner-runner && bun run type-check && bun run test
scripts.precommit:contracts-report: cd libs/contracts/report && ( [ -d node_modules ] || bun install --frozen-lockfile ) && bun run check
scripts.precommit: bun run precommit:web && bun run precommit:scanner && bun run precommit:contracts-report
